en-US.author: Meeting Ringer
en-US.description: Rings whenever you have an upcoming meeting in your calendar linked to a GVC app.
en-US.longDescription: MeetingRinger is a multi-platform native desktop app that rings whenever you have a meeting in your calendar linked to a GVC app (Zoom, Google Meet, Teams, etc.).
en-US.name: Meeting Ringer
en-US.releaseNotes:
🌟 What's New
- Selective Meeting Muting: Disable audio alerts for specific upcoming meetings directly from the timeline cards with a single click, keeping your other alerts active.
- Reimagined Incoming-Call Screen: The ringing window now features a sleek incoming-call layout with platform-brand accent glows, customizable Light and Dark appearance themes, and streamlined Join, Snooze, and Dismiss actions.
- Rich Meeting Timeline Cards: Timeline cards now display organizer details, attendee RSVP statuses, direct links, and an interactive popover with full participant lists.
- Mobile Companion & "On My Way": Added zero-trust end-to-end encrypted mobile companion pairing with secure QR code setup and an "On My Way" handoff action to launch meetings directly on your PC.
- Windows Package Manager Support: MeetingRinger is now available via winget for automated command-line installation and updates.
⚡ Improvements
- Rich Update Release Notes: In-app update dialogs now render full markdown formatting so you can easily review features and improvements before updating.
- Isolated Developer Instances: Development builds now run in isolated environments without interfering with production single-instance locks or settings.
- Verified Installer Integrity: Automated release pipelines now upload and verify installers with VirusTotal Monitor for maximum security and reputation assurance.
🐛 Bug Fixes
- Stale Tray Notifications: Fixed an issue where update alerts could persist in the system tray menu after an update was already installed or dismissed.
- Update Verification & Rollback Support: Improved version comparison logic to support clean rollbacks while rejecting identical versions.
- Copy Meeting Link: Fixed the "Copy Link" action inside the meeting timeline details popover.
- First-Ring Attribution: Ensured the first-ring onboarding event triggers only once per device.
